title: Fail closed when real-media proof rows are unavailable
summary: Normalize unavailable cross-page real-media proof rows to an empty collection before rendering.
reason: A resource-exhausted browser shard exposed that an optional cross-page proof provider could return no value, causing Launch rendering to throw instead of showing conservative unavailable evidence.
behavior_before: Launch assumed an available cross-page proof provider always returned an array and called map directly on its result.
behavior_after: Launch accepts proof rows only when the provider returns an array; unavailable or malformed provider output becomes an empty base set and the existing generated proof rows render conservatively.
manual_validation: PASS: deterministic Node regression covers undefined, null, object, and string provider results.
PASS: all three backend-served WebView real-media smoke tests.
PASS: all three browser-backed lifecycle scenarios, including the exact stop-requested scenario that failed in PR 38 CI.
PASS: complete installed staged pre-commit suite, strict staged change-packet coverage, and git diff --check.
Canonical summaries and duplicate-test inventory regenerated.
rollback_plan: Revert this packet's commit to restore the direct provider result. This may reintroduce a Launch render exception when cross-page evidence is unavailable.
notes: The fallback is display-only and fail-closed. It does not create real-media proof, change backend authority, alter launch readiness, or weaken any browser assertion or timeout. Packet suffix 026 avoids collision with packets 020-025 on concurrent PR 38.
